title: rosa gallica f. ruralis
intro: Rosa gallica f. ruralis, commonly known as Gallica, is a variety of the French rose, a type of rose species native to Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa gallica f. ruralis are thought to be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
